name: Cyril Morlet
title: Integration Engineer — Blockchain Ecosystems · JavaScript & Rust · ex-Bitfinex
summary: Engineer (12 years) who has lived on both sides of blockchain integration. At Bitfinex I integrated L1/L2 chains into a top-tier exchange: deposit/withdrawal pipelines, JSON-RPC clients, reorgs, finality, fee accounting. Since then I build the ecosystem tooling myself: a Rust chain indexer streaming checkpoints into sub-second APIs, a typed transaction SDK, smart contracts in production (Sui Move, ~60K lines across 9 packages; Solidity DeFi background), zkLogin onboarding and gas sponsorship. JavaScript/TypeScript primary for 15 years, working Rust, deep DeFi and cross-chain exposure. Based in Da Nang, Vietnam (ICT).
